# Scale By Power Of 2

![Scale By Power Of 2 function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/numeric/14-multiplier-puissance-2.svg)

[Numeric functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Multiplies the input by two raised to the supplied exponent.
